A concordance table joining T1S2 and T1S3 per hallmark, with an explicit written list of concordant, T1S2-only, and T1S3-only calls.
A stated leave-one-out (sample_01) result for each hallmark significant in T1S2.

plan.title: Hallmark GSEA of psoriasis lesional vs control skin
plan.analytical_narrative:
The research question asks only which MSigDB hallmark pathways differ between the 6 treated (psoriasis lesional) and 6 control skin samples. Differential expression is already done and supplied as /data/inputs/results/de_results.csv (12,000 genes x 8 columns: gene, base_mean, log2_fold_change, log2_fold_change_SE-type fields, p-value, padj), so no DE step is re-planned.

The plan is three short steps in one track. T1S1 validates the supplied DE table before anything is built on it: gene-symbol uniqueness and mappability against the hallmark GMT symbol space, NA handling in log2FC/padj, shrinkage status, and the shape of the p-value distribution. It also produces the single ranking vector that drives GSEA. This matters here because the profile flags sample_01 at ~4x below median library size — a sample that DESeq2 size-factor normalization handles in principle but that can inflate dispersion for low-count genes; the step therefore recomputes a VST/CPM-level sanity check from counts.csv (12,000 x 13, first column gene symbol) plus metadata.csv (12 x 2, condition) and reports whether sample_01 is an outlier in PCA space, so the pathway result can be qualified rather than silently trusted.

T1S2 is the answer to the question: preranked GSEA of the full 12,000-gene ranking against the 50 human MSigDB hallmark sets, using fgsea (multilevel) — rank-based and threshold-free, which is the right choice when the goal is 'which pathways change' rather than 'which pathways are over-represented among an arbitrarily thresholded gene list'. It reports NES, p, BH-adjusted p, set size, leading-edge genes, and direction (up in lesional vs up in control) for all 50 sets, not only the significant ones, so an absent hallmark is distinguishable from an untested one.

T1S3 is an orthogonal, per-sample confirmation: hallmark scores computed on the normalized expression matrix (ssGSEA/GSVA-style via decoupler or GSVA) and tested treated vs control. Preranked GSEA on a summary statistic and per-sample scoring can disagree — where they agree the pathway call is robust; where they do not, the discrepancy is reported rather than hidden. This step is also what exposes whether a hallmark hit is driven by one or two samples (relevant given sample_01), which the preranked test cannot show.
